'''Serres Sarrano''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course on the outskirts of the [[Sullust/Legends|Sullustan]] city of [[Serres Sarrano]].

As of [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], [[Wan Sandage Jr.]] was the track favorite. Serres Sarrano was the second of Sullust's two podraces, and the first of the [[Hutt Championships]].<ref name="Star Wars: Racer Revenge" />
